contamination_risks: The prior 32 outcomes are adverse history and enter every cumulative selection correction.
Only globally untouched reserve pairs enter development or confirmation; contaminated events are dropped without replacement before freeze.
Confirmation prices remain inaccessible before an exact winner is frozen.
family_contract.entry_rule: Require an original as-filed Form 4 direct open-market common-equity purchase, frozen purchase-notional and owner-count thresholds, prior close at least $10, prior 20-session median dollar volume at least $50 million, prior 20-session return no higher than the frozen limit, and ATR cost-floor feasibility; rank one issuer per entry date.

execution_assumptions.entry: next exchange-session open after filing date

family_contract.exit_rule: Exit at the stop or the close of the third or fifth session, with a five-session absolute maximum.
family_contract.expected_holding_behavior: Enter the next full exchange-session open after the Form 4 filing date and hold at most five sessions under an ATR structural stop.
falsifiers: selection-aware statistical rejection across all 64 attempts
any alteration or omission of a prior selection path
family_contract.material_difference_rationale: This is a chronologically disjoint replication of the exact rejected v1 32-trial grid. It does not tune or repair any parameter; it tests whether the prior positive stressed paths replicate in the never-opened 2024 reserve while retaining all prior trials in cumulative selection correction.
family_contract.mechanism: A disclosed, direct open-market purchase by an issuer officer or director may reveal informed demand; larger purchases and purchases clustered across insiders may support short continuation after the filing becomes public.
family_contract.primary_outcome: Selection-adjusted chronological net account growth after 5/10/20-bps per-side costs.

prior_selection_lineage.cumulative_pbo_method: concatenate matching unchanged-grid OOF paths across chronologically disjoint corpora

production_compatibility_risks: SEC filing availability and issuer identity must be fresh.
Overnight positions require confirmed GTC protection and gap-risk sizing.
As-filed symbols may need point-in-time broker symbol reconciliation.
family_contract.ranking_rule: More distinct reporting owners, then higher disclosed purchase notional, then lower prior 20-session return, then canonical symbol.

selection_accounting.cumulative_pbo_method: concatenate matching unchanged-grid OOF paths across chronologically disjoint corpora

family_contract.selection_rule: Evaluate the unchanged 32-trial grid and apply DSR and Holm across all 64 current-plus-prior attempts, cumulative PBO from matching parameter paths concatenated across the two disjoint OOF corpora, plus every frozen account, stress, rolling-fold, and neighbor gate.
family_contract.stop_rule: Stop 1.5 or 2.0 ATR14 below entry; missing, nonpositive, or invalid structural stops are rejected and same-session ambiguity is stop-first.

universe.identity: as-filed SEC issuer CIK and symbol

universe_requirements.identity: point-in-time SEC issuer CIK and as-filed symbol
universe_requirements.security_type: long U.S. common or ordinary equity
